digest.component_or_area: metrics blame derivation and clone documentation
propositions: _blame_file_commits must return None on git failure and [] on successful-but-empty blame to distinguish the two cases
derive_caused_by must abort and return None if any per-path blame fails, preventing wrong caused_by links from partial tallying
A path with legitimately zero blame lines must not abort derivation or suppress the caused_by link
Clone guidance documentation must record measured performance numbers for --filter=blob:none (68.7 MiB / 14.3 s vs full 1.04 GiB / 59 s) and warn against --filter=tree:0
Partial git blame failure can cause derive_caused_by to elect an incorrect culprit by running the strict-majority test over a subset of paths instead of all paths
